title: Parlay archive index (R73)
description: data/parlays/index.json, written by scripts/build_parlay_archive.py: every archived week of the season (data/parlays/<season>_wk<NN>.json, contract parlays_archive.schema.json) sorted by week, plus current_week = the week data/parlays.json holds (the pipeline's default week: scripts/build_predictions.current_week, the earliest week not entirely FINAL). Rewritten only when an entry changes. OPTIONAL: absent until the first archive run; validated strictly when present.

current_week.description: The week data/parlays.json held when the index was written - the PARLAYS default week.

path.description: Repo-relative path of the week's archive file (prefix '/' to fetch from the PWA root).

updated_utc.description: The archived parlays.json updated_utc (the last priced state).

closed.description: Every game of the week FINAL; the file is frozen.
